Product Design & Manufacturing — Four-Year Curriculum

Twenty-four courses, eight semesters. How an idea becomes a product people can buy: sketching, CAD, materials, ergonomics, prototyping, machining, molding, tolerances, electronics, design for manufacturing, costing, quality, lean production, sourcing, certification, patents and launch. Builds on the math and physics core in Biomedical Engineering Foundations. A study aid, not legal or regulatory advice; consult qualified professionals before selling a product.
